incentives.label: Federal clean electricity investment tax credit (Section 48E)
incentives.note: Not applied. IRS Notice 2025-42 (August 2025): under Public Law 119-21 (OBBBA) the Section 48E credit ends for solar facilities placed in service after December 31, 2027 unless construction began by July 4, 2026 (Physical Work Test). A new project would need to be in service by the end of 2027. Rate per the IRS Clean Electricity Investment Credit page (reviewed January 5, 2026): 6% base, up to 30% with prevailing wage and apprenticeship requirements, plus 10 points each for domestic content and energy communities; foreign-entity rules also apply. Confirm eligibility with a tax adviser, then enter the amount.
incentives.source: IRS Notice 2025-42 (n-25-42.pdf); IRS Clean Electricity Investment Credit page (reviewed 05-Jan-2026).
